description: Defines the resource_grid_mapper interface for mapping resource elements into a resource grid, including nested classes for symbol buffering and configuration structures.

classes.name: resource_grid_mapper
classes.description: Interface for mapping resource elements into a resource grid, used by downlink channel processors.

classes.name: resource_grid_mapper::symbol_buffer
classes.description: Abstract class representing a buffer of complex symbols with methods to retrieve and pop symbols.

classes.name: resource_grid_mapper::symbol_buffer_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class that wraps a span of symbols to conform to the symbol_buffer interface.

classes.name: resource_grid_mapper::allocation_configuration
classes.description: Structure describing resource grid allocation parameters including bandwidth part, frequency, and time allocations.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps resource elements into the resource grid based on input data, pattern, and configuration.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps complex symbols onto the resource grid with specified allocation and reserved elements.
